text:
jana: bringing up Nightingale-11B int4 on dev cluster, seeing 15% token throughput drop and sporadic OOMs when requests hit >180 max_new_tokens.

mike: logs?

jana: pasted recent server dump:
```
2026-03-20T12:34:56Z ERROR oom on device 0: alloc failed 1.2GB
kv_cache_slots=1024 slab_free=128 slab_used=896
prefetch_workers=4 max_new_tokens=256 batch_size=16
```

sam: bench note: after int4 quant perf p50 ok but p95 latency +40% at higher max_new_tokens, memory footprint grows non-linearly.

leo: sounds like slab fragmentation + KV cache growth. any regressed evals?

jana: subtle quality drop on long-form summarization (ROUGE-L -0.9). small but consistent with int4 kernel change.

anya: removing quantization isn't an option for prod. plan?

mike: propose changes to defaults for this model: reduce default max_new_tokens to 128, enable kv_prefix_cache with slot cap, and lower prefetch workers to 2. also add aggressive KV eviction for sessions >512 tokens.

jana: can we test with canary: model flag nightingale11b.int4.max_new_tokens=128 and nightingale11b.int4.kv_slot_cap=512 ?

sam: I'll run microbench: workload=conversations+long-summaries, batch sweep [8,16,32], max_new_tokens [128,192,256]

ci-bot: test job queued: run-3261234567-night-bench-1

leo: also add guard in runtime to fall back to int8 variant on OOMs for high max_new_tokens.

mike: implemented fallback hook in branch `runtime/fallback/int8-nightingale` — will push canary later today.

jana: good. if canary looks stable we'll ship change to model defaults and rollout to Dedicated first. I'll post results in ~3h.

sam: preliminary: with max_new_tokens=128 + kv_slot_cap=512 p95 latency back to baseline and no OOMs in 30m smoke. quality delta unchanged vs 256 though — need eval reach.

anya: thumbs up. let's keep an eye for regressions in mid-term evals. :eyes:

mike: plan sounds solid. I'll open rollout PR and add feature flag.

jana: thanks team — tagging @eng-sre for monitoring dashboards once canary goes live.
